ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Via PowerShell Remote Thread
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects remote thread creation by PowerShell processes into "lsass.exe" Note: Unmapped fields: SourceImage, TargetImage

sequences.query: ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$"))
